messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Striped datatables
parts:
You can certainly use CSS to adjust the background color if you find
it not dark enough, e.g. (in ui.R)

tags$head(
tags$style(HTML(
'.table-striped tbody>tr:nth-child(odd)>td,
.table-striped tbody>tr:nth-child(odd)>th {
background-color: gray;
}'
))
)


Regards,
Yihui
